run_autohome.description: Set to 'yes' to enable autohome service in initscript.

run_autogroup.description: Set to 'yes' to enable autogroup service in initscript.

autohome_home.description: Mount point for virtual home directories visible to applications.

autogroup_home.description: Mount point for virtual group directories visible to applications.

autohome_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds before autohome mount is considered inactive and unmounted.

autogroup_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds before autogroup mount is considered inactive and unmounted.

autohome_realpath.description: Real filesystem path where home directories are physically stored.

autohome_level.description: Directory depth level for structuring home directories (e.g., 2 = /a/ab/abc).

autohome_skel.description: Path to skeleton files copied into new home directories.

autogroup_realpath.description: Real filesystem path where group directories are physically stored.

autogroup_level.description: Directory depth level for structuring group directories.

autohome_backup_cmd.description: Command to run for autohome backup (empty = disabled).

autogroup_backup_cmd.description: Command to run for autogroup backup (empty = disabled).

autohome_backwait.description: Seconds to wait after unmount before triggering autohome backup (max 86400).

autogroup_backwait.description: Seconds to wait after unmount before triggering autogroup backup (max 86400).

autohome_backpri.description: Backup priority (1–40) for autohome backups; lower = higher priority.

autogroup_backpri.description: Backup priority (1–40) for autogroup backups; lower = higher priority.

autohome_maxback.description: Max concurrent backup processes allowed for autohome.

autogroup_maxback.description: Max concurrent backup processes allowed for autogroup.
